messages:
Alex: Heads up — we're planning to land audit schema v4 this week. It adds explicit privileged_action events (RBAC changes, role grants/revokes) and a kms_key_rotation event. Need quick sanity check on customer-facing samples and changelog language before we announce.

Jamie: sgtm. Is v4 purely additive? worried about customers parsing events with strict schemas.

Alex: Additive only — we kept old fields. We'll bump schema_version to "4" and continue emitting legacy "event_type" for compat. But privileged_action will have structured details we expect customers to consume.

Morgan: FYI the pipeline currently normalizes user_id and ip_address, but doesn't capture actor_roles or grant_scope. We'll need to extend the ingest mapping.

Priya: For KMS rotation, what's the canonical event shape? e.g., rotation triggered by auto-rotate vs manual key import.

Alex: Draft sample payload below — please sanity check fields we should expose publicly. we should avoid including key material or KMS ARN full path in public examples.

```
{
  "schema_version": "4",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T21:07:02Z",
  "event_type": "privileged_action",
  "action": "role_grant",
  "resource": "project:payments",
  "actor": {
    "principal_type": "user",
    "principal_id": "u_12345",
    "actor_roles": ["admin","infra:deploy"]
  },
  "details": {
    "granted_role": "secrets_reader",
    "grant_scope": "project:payments",
    "reason": "requested during incident triage"
  },
  "metadata": {
    "request_id": "req-8a7f",
    "region": "us-west-2"
  }
}
```

Morgan: Looks good. Suggest adding "privileged_action" as a top-level enum with values: role_grant, role_revoke, permission_change, kms_key_rotation, kms_key_import.

Priya: For customer-facing sample pack I want: one privileged_action example, one kms_key_rotation example (sanitized), and a short note on PII/how we redact. I'll draft and drop into the docs PR.

Jamie: I'll update docs/observability/audit-events.md with the new fields and add a migration note. Also will include an example of a tolerant parser snippet in Python.

deploy-bot: deploy started: audit-schema/v4 -> staging

security-ops: I'll run the new sample smoke tests against staging (audit-visibility smoke set) and post results here. :white_check_mark:

Alex: Thanks all. Action items:
- Priya: draft customer sample pack + redaction note
- Jamie: docs PR + migration snippet
- Morgan: update ingest mapping to include actor_roles/grant_scope
- Security-ops: run smoke tests and confirm coverage
I'll assemble the changelog blurb after we have the smoke pass and legal OK for messaging, then we'll announce in #announcements.

Alex: tagging @Priya and @Jamie for visibility. :eyes:
